title: Abyss
caption: Abyss (V)
game_text: Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) your total battle destiny = 1. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.
lore: Careless abuse of the Force by a young Jedi trainee can have dire consequences. When hanging from the weather vane of Cloud City, Luke’s balance was his only hope.
